tasks.title: Make composer clearly primary
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0357-01 offers one labelled box for a musical request with a short hint' passed 2026-11-10. Needs a person: first-message usability test.

tasks.title: Keep exact scope visible
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLxPage.test.tsx 'asks about the second of two identical songs by its own occurrence, and the label can be removed' and 'removing the scope label means the next message has no scope' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Protect Send semantics
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0357-03 Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line and IME composition never submits' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Retain unsent drafts per thread
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLxPage.test.tsx 'keeps each conversation's unsent words through switching and a reload, never mixing them' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Expose running and Stop safely
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0357-05 shows Stop only while Lucy is working and explains that sending replaces the run' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Arbitrate keyboard and player
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/shell/Shell.test.tsx (visualViewport sets --keyboard-inset) passed 2026-11-10 and lucy.css lifts the composer by --bottom-chrome plus --keyboard-inset. Needs a person: physical iOS and Android software-keyboard occlusion check.

tasks.title: Keep voice optional and inert
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0357-07 voice input only fills the box for editing, it never sends' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Validate touch and AT parity
tasks.evidence: Needs a person: one-handed Ask, Edit, Send, Stop study at 320px with TalkBack and VoiceOver.

tasks.title: Group meaningful milestones
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/lucy/reducer.test.ts 'updates exactly the card each step event names, in any order' and 'never regresses a settled step' passed 2026-11-10 (cards built only from plan.started and step.* events). Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Keep tool data truthful
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0358-02 and -04 draw only what the step returned, and say unknown for the rest' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Refine compact card hierarchy
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0358-03 a long plan leads with what failed and what is running' passed 2026-11-10. Needs a person: long-run hierarchy study.

tasks.title: Visualise musical steps
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0358-02 and -04 draw only what the step returned' passed 2026-11-10 (search, transition and order mini-visuals from LucyVisuals.tsx). Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Handle progress responsibly
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0358-05 a known total is numeric, an unknown total says so, with no time estimate' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Make permission actions distinct
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0358-06 a permission request is its own card with its own answer, outside the step log' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Respect motion preferences
tasks.evidence: Evidence: web/src/views/LucyLx.test.tsx 'LX-0358-07 the moving cue is only for real running work and goes when motion is Still' and web/src/styles/lx-design-language.test.tsx 'LX-0364-06' passed 2026-11-10. Reviewer: none.

tasks.title: Validate working-state trust
tasks.evidence: Needs a person: comprehension study with mixed runs (what happened, was anything saved or played).

tasks.title: Document motion rules
